name: Proper Ordered Sample Compression / Log Shattering (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter admits a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For $\mathcal S_n$, proper ordered sample-compression size is $n-1$, while log shattering is $\log_2(n+1)$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the half-interval class $\mathcal I_n$, log shattering is $\log_2 n$, while proper ordered sample-compression size is $1$.
proof: The two canonical value calculations give unbounded gaps in the two directions.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Proper Ordered Sample Compression and Log Shattering of Half-Intervals and Singletons.
